### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Workspaces tab offers the workspace-manager sign-in](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3176) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Customize's Workspaces tab shows `Sign in to use workspaces` with the sign-in, instead of muster's raw `auth_required` refusal, when you haven't signed in to the workspace-manager yet, and reads your workspaces once you have.

### Development and CI/CD
